title: Confirmation Bias in Generative AI Chatbots: Mechanisms, Risks, Mitigation Strategies, and Future Research Directions
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it. The focus is on the general mechanisms, risks, and mitigation strategies for confirmation bias in generative AI chatbots.
